login_invalid: Invalid email or password, or this account has no admin access.
login_throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login_required_fields: Fill in your email and password.
dashboard_score_reports_text: Results sent in the last 24 hours
dashboard_flash_interviews_text: Flash Interviews edited in the last 48 hours
dashboard_users_text: Total users registered in the system
dashboard_tutorials_text: A playlist of videos explaining how to do some tasks on the website. Depending on the permissions of your account, you may not see every option shown in the videos.
error_forbidden: You do not have permission to access this page.
form_delete_in_use: Cannot delete: other records still use it.
form_read_only: You can only view this record.
form_upload_failed: The file could not be saved. Try again.
select_error: The options could not be loaded.
validation_url: Invalid address: use an http:// or https:// link.
validation_file_too_big: The file cannot be larger than {max}.
validation_not_found: The selected record no longer exists.
clubs_emblem_hint: PNG or SVG, up to 1000 KB. Cropped to a square (800 px); PNG keeps transparency.
clubs_admin_user_hint: User who manages the club on the site.
clubs_priority_hint: From 0 to 100. Clubs with a higher priority are listed first.
clubs_no_teams: This club has no teams yet.
clubs_birthday_post_hint: Posts on social media on the founding day.
clubs_name_taken: A club with this name already exists.
clubs_delete_cascade: This also deletes {teams} team(s), {games} game(s) of those teams and {playgrounds} playground(s).
teams_search_placeholder: Search by team, club or ID…
teams_delete_cascade: This also deletes {games} game(s) of this team, and {players} player(s) are left without a team.
partners_url_hint: Where the ad takes people who click it.
partners_priority_hint: From 1 to 100. Lower numbers are shown first.
partners_picture_hint: JPEG or PNG, up to 19.5 MB. Resized to at most 2048 px.
partners_visible_hint: Shows the ad on the site.
select_search_media: Search media by tags or ID…
articles_title_hint: Can only change while the article is hidden: the public link is built from the title.
articles_title_locked: The title of a visible article cannot change (its public link depends on it). Hide the article to change it.
articles_description_hint: Up to 280 characters. When empty, the start of the text is used.
articles_visible_hint: Shows the article on the site.
articles_cover_media_hint: An image or video already in the media library.
articles_cover_upload_hint: JPEG or PNG, up to 19.5 MB. It is added to the media library and becomes the cover.
articles_not_owner: Only the author or an admin can change this article.
pages_search_placeholder: Search by title, name, slug or ID…
pages_title_hint: The public link (/p/…) is built from the title and changes with it.
pages_title_no_slug: The title needs letters or digits (the public link is built from it).
pages_slug_taken: A page already uses the link /p/{slug}. Pick another title.
pages_name_hint: Short name used in the site’s page lists.
pages_body_too_long: The text is too long (at most 64 KB of HTML).
pages_visible_hint: Shows the page on the site.
pages_picture_hint: Optional. JPEG or PNG, up to 19.5 MB. Resized to at most 2048 px.
media_tags_hint: Separated by commas. Used to find the file.
media_file_hint: Up to 195 MB. Images are resized to at most 2048 px; videos (MP4, AVI) and other files are kept as uploaded.
media_url_hint: Link to a YouTube video, an image or another file.
media_url_taken: This link is already in the media library.
media_link_failed: Could not make a thumbnail from this link. Check that the address is right and public.
media_visible_hint: Only visible media can be picked as an article cover.
media_not_owner: Only the uploader (or an admin) can change or delete this file.
media_delete_covers: {count} article(s) using it as cover will have no cover.
media_delete_in_use: The file is still shown in {count} other record(s) (texts, clubs, players, …), so it is kept: it only leaves the media library.
media_deleted_file_kept: Media #{id} deleted. The file was kept because other records still use it.
polls_search_placeholder: Search by question, slug or ID…
polls_question_hint: The public link (/sondagens/…) is made from the question and does not change afterwards.
polls_question_hint_edit: Changing the question makes the legacy site generate the poll image again.
polls_question_no_slug: The question must have letters or numbers (the public link is made from it).
polls_answers_hint: Between {min} and {max} answers. They can't be changed once the poll is created.
polls_answers_locked: The answers can't be changed once the poll is created.
polls_answers_min: The poll needs at least {min} answers.
polls_answers_max: The poll can have at most {max} answers.
polls_publish_after_hint: The poll shows on the site from this date.
polls_publish_locked: The poll is already published: its publish date can't change any more.
polls_close_after_hint: No more votes after this date.
polls_show_results_after_hint: Until then, voters don't see the results.
polls_timezone_hint: Dates and times in the {timezone} timezone.
polls_image_hint: Image for sharing on social media, generated from the question by the legacy site.
polls_image_pending: The legacy site will generate the image again within a minute.
polls_delete_text: Its answers and {votes} vote(s) are deleted too.
players_search_placeholder: Search by name, nickname, association number or ID…
players_name_hint: Saved with capital initials (e.g. “joão silva” → “João Silva”).
players_association_id_taken: Another player already has this association number.
players_team_hint: Changing the team (or leaving it empty) records a transfer dated today.
players_obs_hint: Internal notes, not shown on the site.
players_picture_hint: Optional. JPEG or PNG, up to 2 MB. Cropped square (800 px).
players_picture_url_hint: The server downloads the image. If you also pick a file, the file is used.
players_picture_url_failed: Could not download the image from this link.
players_picture_url_not_image: The link is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
players_visible_hint: Shows the player on the site.
players_transfers_hint: The 10 most recent. They are recorded when the player's team changes.
players_transfers_empty: This player has no transfers yet.
players_delete_usage: This also deletes {goals} goal(s), {votes} MVP vote(s) and {transfers} transfer(s).
players_delete_agents: It can't be deleted: it is linked to {count} coach(es). Remove it from those first.
update_requests_search_placeholder: Search by name, nickname, club, request or player ID…
update_requests_changes_hint: Every change is selected. Untick the ones you don't want to apply.
update_requests_no_changes: The request changes nothing on the player.
update_requests_club_unknown: No club has this name (or it has no visible teams). Pick the team:
update_requests_team_required: Pick the team the player moves to.
update_requests_notes_placeholder: Optional to approve, required to deny
update_requests_deny_reason: To deny, write the reason (3 to 1000 characters).
update_requests_duplicates_hint: Players with the same name or association number already exist.
update_requests_player_missing: The player of this request no longer exists.
update_requests_name_missing: The request has no name: the player can't be created.
update_requests_delete_text: The request is deleted without changing the player.
team_agents_search_placeholder: Search by name, external ID or ID…
team_agents_team_hint_create: The history starts with this team and role.
team_agents_team_hint: Changing the team or role adds a history entry (or corrects today's).
team_agents_player_hint: Links the coach to their player record, if they have one.
team_agents_external_id_hint: Identifier at the association or another source.
team_agents_history_hint: Teams and roles over time. Two entries in a row can't be the same, and two can't be on the same day.
team_agents_history_team_hint: Leave empty if they had no team.
team_agents_history_repeated: The entry would sit next to another with the same team and role. It adds nothing to the history.
team_agents_history_same_day: Another entry is already on that day. Pick another date or edit that entry.
team_agents_history_delete_repeats: It can't be deleted: the entries before and after it would end up next to each other with the same team and role. Delete one of them first.
team_agents_delete_history: Its {count} history entry(ies) are deleted too.
select_search_players: Search player by name, nickname or ID…
users_search_placeholder: Search by name, email or ID…
users_permissions_hint: What this account can do in the admin. Changes apply immediately.
users_cannot_grant: You can't grant or remove “{permission}”: only an admin manages permissions they don't hold.
users_cannot_revoke_own: You can't remove “{permission}” from yourself: you would lose access.
users_ban_text: The account can no longer sign in to the site or the admin, and any admin session ends right away.
users_ban_reason_hint: 3 to 155 characters. Kept in the ban history.
users_pardon_text: The account can sign in again. The ban stays in the history as pardoned.
competitions_priority_hint: Higher priority competitions come first on the site (0 to 100000).
competitions_visible_hint: Shows the competition on the site.
competitions_social_media_hint: The legacy site posts this competition's games on social media.
competitions_picture_hint: Required. JPEG or PNG, up to 19.5 MB.
competitions_picture_hint_edit: Optional: replaces the current one. JPEG or PNG, up to 19.5 MB.
competitions_name_taken: Another competition already has this name.
competitions_delete_usage: This also deletes {seasons} season(s) and {groups} group(s), none with games.
seasons_search_placeholder: Search by competition, name, year or ID…
seasons_years_hint: Same as the start year for single-year seasons.
seasons_end_before_start: The end year can't be before the start year.
seasons_display_name_hint: Optional. Replaces the competition name on the site for this season.
seasons_visible_hint: Shows the season on the site.
seasons_picture_hint: Optional. Replaces the competition logo for this season. JPEG or PNG, up to 19.5 MB.
seasons_clear_picture_hint: Goes back to the competition logo.
seasons_delete_usage: This also deletes the season's {groups} group(s), none with games.
game_groups_search_placeholder: Search by group, competition, year or ID…
game_groups_rules_hint: They define the standings: points, colour bands and tie-breaker.
group_rules_name_taken: Other rules already have this name.
group_rules_bands_hint: Positions coloured in the table (e.g. “1,2,3” in green, “Apuramento de Campeão”).
group_rules_position_repeated: Position {position} is already in another band.
group_rules_tie_breaker_hint: How to order teams level on points.
group_rules_script_hint: JavaScript run by the legacy site. The new site only recognises the AFPB rule.
group_rules_delete_in_use: These rules are used by groups and can't be deleted.
select_search_seasons: Search season by competition or year…
competitions_delete_has_games: This competition has {count} game(s) and can't be deleted. Delete or move the games first.
seasons_delete_has_games: This season has {count} game(s) and can't be deleted. Delete or move the games first.
game_groups_delete_has_games: This group has {count} game(s) and can't be deleted. Delete or move the games first.
games_same_team: Pick a team other than the home team.
games_result_hint: Leave the goals empty for the site to count them from the game's recorded goals.
games_postponed_hint: Shows the game as postponed on the site.
games_visible_hint: Shows the game on the site.
games_scoreboard_updates_hint: Lets the public send the live score.
games_referees_hint: Up to 8 referees, each with a role.
games_referee_repeated: This referee is already in the game.
games_delete_usage: This also deletes {goals} goal(s), {votes} MVP vote(s) and {comments} flash interview(s).
select_search_groups: Search group by competition, year or name…
game_comments_intro: After each game the legacy site sends each club a link and a PIN to comment on it. The comments go into the automatically generated match report.
game_comments_new_hint: Creates the link and PIN for a club to comment on the game, as the legacy site does after each game. No email is sent: share the link.
game_comments_search_placeholder: Search by club, comment or ID…
game_comments_content_hint: Plain text, up to 1000 characters (HTML is removed).
game_comments_content_new_hint: Optional: the club writes it through the link. Plain text, up to 1000 characters.
game_comments_deadline_hint: The club can write until this date. Extend it to give them more time.
game_comments_used_info: This comment was already used in an automatically generated report. Changing it here doesn't change the report.
game_comments_exists: This club already has a flash interview for this game.
select_search_games: Search game by club or ID…
goals_search_placeholder: Search by player, club or ID…
goals_team_hint: The team that scores (for an own goal, the team that benefits).
goals_player_hint: Optional: leave empty if the scorer is unknown.
goals_own_goal_hint: Set automatically when the player currently plays for the other team in this game.
